2609.21573.title: Micro-Collaborative Poisoning: A Distributed Attack on RAG Systems
2609.21573.paper_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves large language models by grounding outputs in external knowledge sources, but this dependency also creates a surface for poisoning attacks. This paper introduces Micro-Collaborative Poisoning, a distributed attack in which a false target claim is divided across multiple locally plausible documents instead of being concentrated in a single malicious passage. We evaluate the attack across 108 RAG configurations by varying dataset, retriever architecture, retrieval depth, database composition, number of poisoned databases, and generator model. The results indicate that Micro-Collaborative Poisoning is not driven by a single dominant poisoned passage, but by the accumulation of weak adversarial signals across retrieved sources. Increasing top-$k$ and poisoning multiple databases make it more likely that these signals will appear together in the retrieved context, while clean database diversity and stronger retrievers can reduce their influence. The document-level poisoning visibility analysis further shows that this threat is difficult to expose through isolated document inspection, since Micro-Collaborative Poisoning achieves downstream influence while leaving a weaker explicit poisoning signature than direct poisoning.
2609.21573.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）通過將輸出基於外部知識來源來改善大型語言模型，但這種依賴性也為毒害攻擊創造了表面。本文介紹了微協作毒害，這是一種分散式攻擊，其中虛假的目標聲明被分散在多個本地合理的文檔中，而不是集中在單個惡意段落中。我們通過改變數據集、檢索器架構、檢索深度、數據庫組成、被毒害數據庫的數量和生成模型，對108個RAG配置進行了攻擊評估。結果表明，微協作毒害並不是由單一主導的被毒害段落驅動，而是由檢索來源中弱對抗信號的累積驅動。增加top-$k$和毒害多個數據庫使這些信號更有可能在檢索的上下文中一起出現，而乾淨數據庫的多樣性和更強的檢索器可以減少它們的影響。文檔級毒害可見性分析進一步顯示，這種威脅難以通過孤立的文檔檢查來揭露，因為微協作毒害在留下比直接毒害更弱的明確毒害簽名的同時，實現了下游影響。
